title: Cookie Management & Tracking Prevention Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your tracking risk from browser cookies and get personalized recommendations for better cookie management and privacy protection.
description: Assess your vulnerability to tracking cookies and third-party data collection. Get a personalized risk score and actionable recommendations to improve your browser privacy through better cookie management strategies.

formula: const browserScores = { chrome: 30, firefox: 20, safari: 15, edge: 25, incognito: 5, other: 20 }; const cookieScores = { accept_all: 40, default: 30, block_third_party: 15, block_all: 5, custom: 10 }; const clearingScores = { never: 30, yearly: 25, monthly: 15, weekly: 8, daily: 3, session: 0 }; const websiteScores = { minimal: 5, mixed: 15, social_heavy: 25, shopping: 20, everything: 30 }; let baseScore = browserScores[browserType] + cookieScores[cookieSettings] + clearingScores[clearingFrequency] + websiteScores[websiteTypes]; baseScore += (browsingHours * 1.5); if (trackingProtection) baseScore -= 10; if (adBlocker) baseScore -= 8; const riskScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(baseScore))); const trackingExposure = Math.round(riskScore * 0.8); let riskLevel; if (riskScore <= 25) riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; else if (riskScore <= 50) riskLevel = 'Medium Risk'; else if (riskScore <= 75) riskLevel = 'High Risk'; else riskLevel = 'Very High Risk'; return { riskScore, riskLevel, trackingExposure };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your tracking risk based on browser choice, cookie settings, clearing frequency, protection tools, and browsing habits. It considers how different browsers handle cookies by default, the effectiveness of various cookie policies, and the impact of security tools on reducing tracking exposure.
tips: Switch to privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser for enhanced protection
Enable 'Block third-party cookies' in your browser settings
Clear cookies weekly or use automatic deletion after each session
Install reputable ad blockers that include anti-tracking features
Use incognito/private mode for sensitive browsing
Regularly audit and delete unnecessary cookies manually
Consider using container tabs to isolate different types of browsing
